verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation provides an app store integrating Fedora repos and Flathub for browsers, chat clients, etc. (fedora-docs-1), and users report solid out-of-box experience (fedora-comm-6, fedora-comm-10). However, community feedback notes friction with Flatpak setup for apps like Discord/Spotify (fedora-comm-14) and gaps for professional/proprietary software like Adobe or CUDA (fedora-comm-8), indicating everyday app coverage isn't fully seamless for all switchers.
